<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-reference.mjs. Edit the repository definition and its Markdown documentation. -->

Clean package caches and package lists.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

## Parameters

| Name         | Default | Description                                                                                       |
| ------------ | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `autoremove` | `false` | With APT, remove automatically installed packages that are no longer required. Ignored on Alpine. |

## Scheduling

| Setting      | Value     |
| ------------ | --------- |
| Priority     | `-900000` |
| Dependencies | None      |

Higher priorities run first within the selected recipe set. Dependencies include
other recipes; their priorities determine execution order.

## Behavior

Runs late so other recipes can install packages first. On APT-based systems, set
autoremove when the final filesystem should also drop packages no longer
required by installed packages. Alpine ignores this option.

## Example

For example, add the recipe to a layer derived from a compatible base:

```toml
recipes = ["core/pkg-cleanup"]
```
